properties.description: The agent that signed in to flo2.io as OAuth client https://claude.ai/oauth/claude-code-client-metadata (the sign-in token names it, and flo2 checks the token), calling itself "claude-code/2.1.292 (cli)" in its requests (its own word, not checked). flo2.io records it as the agent a change went through, beside the signed-in person it was for: attribution only, never an approval.
